page_title: FRA 3-1 SEN | France v Senegal 16/06/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+10' Half-chance! Ibrahim Mbaye (Senegal) plays a pass into the box, but Mike Maignan reacts well to snuff out the attack.
90+8' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Krepin Diatta (Senegal).

90+6' 3 - 1 What a beautiful moment! Kylian Mbappe (France) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the top of the net. Edouard Mendy just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 3:1.
90+5' 2 - 1 Ibrahim Mbaye (Senegal) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Mike Maignan with a strike into the right side of the goal. He makes it 2:1.
90+4' Krepin Diatta (Senegal) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
90+3' Dangerous play by El Hadji Malick Diouf (Senegal). Alireza Faghani blows his whistle for a foul.
90+2' Habib Diarra (Senegal) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Alireza Faghani blows his whistle for a foul.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
90' The corner from El Hadji Malick Diouf (Senegal) is hurriedly cleared.
88' Idrissa Gueye will be replaced by Pathe Ciss (Senegal).
87' Substitution. Rayan Cherki (France) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Desire Doue walks off.
86' Kylian Mbappe (France) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. If it wasn't for Edouard Mendy's superb save the ball would have probably ended up in the bottom left corner.
83' Pape Bouna Thiaw has decided to substitute Nicolas Jackson and he is replaced by Bamba Dieng (Senegal).
83' Pape Bouna Thiaw has decided to make a change. Iliman Ndiaye (Senegal) replaces Pape Gueye.
82' 2 - 0 Goal! Adrien Rabiot gets to the ball, slips Bradley Barcola (France) into the area and he scores with a delightful chipped finish to make it 2:0.
80' The attendance for today's match is 80545.
80' Didier Deschamps prepares a substitution. Ousmane Dembele is replaced by Bradley Barcola (France).
80' Nicolas Jackson (Senegal) is flagged for offside.
78' Michael Olise (France) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
77' Alireza Faghani blows his whistle and it's Kylian Mbappe (France) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

77' Habib Diarra (Senegal) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. It's a free kick to France, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
76' Pape Bouna Thiaw decides to make a substitution. Lamine Camara will be replaced by Habib Diarra (Senegal).
75' Here's the change. Ismaila Sarr leaves the pitch and Ibrahim Mbaye (Senegal) comes on as a substitute.
75' Michael Olise (France) takes the corner with a short pass.

74' Desire Doue (France) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom left corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Edouard Mendy, who tips the ball around the post. France have been awarded a corner kick.
73' El Hadji Malick Diouf (Senegal) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
73' Lamine Camara (Senegal) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Senegal have a corner.

72' Michael Olise (France) collects a rebound a long way out and doesn't hesitate to release a goal-bound hammer of a shot. His attempt is precise and low towards the middle of the target. It would have ended in the back of the net if it wasn't for Edouard Mendy and his nice save.
72' Jules Kounde (France) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
69' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
68' Nicolas Jackson (Senegal) has a goal ruled out for offside!

66' 1 - 0 A superb goal from great team play! Kylian Mbappe (France) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot into the middle of the net. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
66' Theo Hernandez (France) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
64' Michael Olise (France) tries to find Kylian Mbappe, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
61' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty as the referee indicates there was no infringement.
59' Referee Alireza Faghani makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
58' PENALTY APPEAL after Kylian Mbappe (France) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
58' France work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
57' Kylian Mbappe (France) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. France will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
57' Kylian Mbappe (France) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper.
56' Ismaila Sarr (Senegal) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Nicolas Jackson.
53' Edouard Mendy comes off his line to intercept the corner from Michael Olise (France).

53' Great touch by Michael Olise (France) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save! The ball is out of play and France manage to earn a corner.
52' Ismaila Sarr (Senegal) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
51' The ball is cleared after Kylian Mbappe (France) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
50' The linesman raises his flag. Jules Kounde (France) is adjudged offside.
47' Desire Doue (France) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!
46' Alireza Faghani has a clear sight and sees a foul from Lamine Camara (Senegal).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' A precise short pass from Sadio Mane releases Ismaila Sarr (Senegal) in space inside the box, but he smashes a wild shot high over the bar.
45+5' Ousmane Dembele (France) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball is behind the touchline and Senegal will take a throw-in.
45' 6 additional min. will be played.
45' Michael Olise (France) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Edouard Mendy has no trouble gathering it.

44' Ousmane Dembele (France) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. France are awarded a corner kick.
44' Kylian Mbappe (France) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
44' The free kick is taken by Ousmane Dembele (France), but ball is cleared.
43' Ismaila Sarr (Senegal) is able to continue to play.
43' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Idrissa Gueye (Senegal). A free kick is awarded to France.
40' The game is interrupted now, Ismaila Sarr (Senegal) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
40' Sadio Mane (Senegal) takes a long-range shot, but his attempt is not a big threat to the goalkeeper.
39' Ismaila Sarr (Senegal) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
34' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 1:3.
32' Alireza Faghani blows his whistle after Jules Kounde (France) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
31' Ismaila Sarr (Senegal) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
30' Lamine Camara (Senegal) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Alireza Faghani has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
26' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
26' Lamine Camara (Senegal) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
25' Nicolas Jackson (Senegal) blows a big chance! He quickly whipped the ball from inside the box towards the net to beat the keeper, but his effort crashes against the left post.
23' Desire Doue (France) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
23' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Kylian Mbappe (France) takes it short.
23' Kylian Mbappe (France) sent a pass onto Adrien Rabiot, who didn't get a chance to finish. The ball goes out of play and France have been awarded a corner kick.
21' Michael Olise (France) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
21' Jules Kounde (France) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Corner kick. France will have an opportunity.
19' Ismaila Sarr (Senegal) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
19' Ousmane Dembele (France) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
15' The free kick is taken short by France.
15' Idrissa Gueye (Senegal) jumps into a tackle and Alireza Faghani signals a foul. A free kick to France.
14' Ousmane Dembele (France) tries to find Kylian Mbappe, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
12' Good clearance! Kylian Mbappe (France) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
10' Some neat passing and movement from Senegal as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
8' Nicolas Jackson (Senegal) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
7' Ismaila Sarr (Senegal) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
4' The referee blows his whistle as Adrien Rabiot (France) was too aggressive in his challenge.
4' Kylian Mbappe (France) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
3' The foul by Nicolas Jackson (Senegal) was seen by Alireza Faghani who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
3' Senegal quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

1' El Hadji Malick Diouf (Senegal) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The referee points to the corner flag and Senegal will take a corner.
